title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI Price Cuts & Sol Acceleration: OpenAI slashed API pricing for GPT-5.6 Luna by 80% and GPT-5.6 Terra by 20%, while introducing faster inference for GPT-5.6 Sol and extending usage credits in Codex.

Autonomous Agent Infra & Claude Code: Anthropic reported 90% of internal code is now written by Claude Code, while open-source projects like LoopX and Qwen3.8-Max push 200+ hour driftless agent execution and 2.4T parameter coding capabilities.

Anthropic Commercial Scale & Culture: Market reports estimate Anthropic's ARR reached billion in July with targets toward billion, even as leadership focuses on mission alignment amidst rapid expansion.
Corporate Treasury Moves: Strategy reported liquidating 1,637 Bitcoin (M), while enterprise Lightning infrastructure providers like LQWD emphasize debt-free treasury structures.

Developer Workflows & Open Science: Vercel's production next-forge template hit 7.5k stars for full-stack Next.js scaffolding, while Lean 4 initiatives like OPH bring formal verification to fundamental physics.

items.title: @OpenAI: GPT-5.6 Price Cuts & Sol API Acceleration
items.body: OpenAI announced major API price reductions for the GPT-5.6 family, cutting GPT-5.6 Luna costs by 80% and GPT-5.6 Terra by 20%. They also launched a faster option for GPT-5.6 Sol and reflected savings across Codex and ChatGPT Work.

items.title: @xiaohu: Anthropic Internal Claude Code & Dev Role Evolution
items.body: Anthropic engineering leaders shared that 90% of internal code is now written by Claude Code. Traditional front/backend roles are evolving into five distinct profiles: Prototyper, Builder, Maintainer, Scaler, and Finisher.

items.title: @Alibaba_Qwen: Qwen3.8-Max & Open Weights Announcement
items.body: Alibaba Qwen introduced Qwen3.8-Max, a 2.4T parameter model designed for multi-day autonomous coding and complex workflow planning, with open-weights for Qwen3.8-27B releasing soon.

items.title: @yifanxu_ephai: LoopX Long-Horizon Agent State Kernel
items.body: ByteDance OpenViking contributors launched LoopX, an open-source lightweight state kernel enabling AI agents to run continuously for 200+ hours without goal drift by managing structured state, authority, and evidence.

items.title: @ValerioCapraro: Math Problem Solving vs Conceptual Jumps in LLMs
